title: testjig: advertise blob2 and blob, register blob handlers
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B19. Crates: jmap-testjig. Size: S.

Per docs/design/blobext.md §9 'testjig': advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob2 with the real BlobAccountCapability in accountCapabilities (the capability loop currently writes {}, violating blobext-03 §2.1 'MUST contain') and urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob with its rfc9404() view (decision 11), {} in capabilities for both; register_blob_handlers on the memory backend. The jig's blob store is separate from the mail/filenode stores, so cross-type lookups are out of scope. Acceptance: an HTTP test runs -03 §9.1 Blob/set then Blob/get, and RFC 9404 §4.1.2 Blob/upload then Blob/get, end to end; Session JSON carries all 17 blob2 keys and the 4 blob keys.
